notes.title: 001 Earth - Update Version 0.0.2.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings, Adventurers!

We are thrilled to announce the release of version 0.0.2.0 for 001 Earth. This update brings significant enhancements to the game's world generation, focusing primarily on the forest biome. Here’s what you can expect in this latest update:

New Features and Improvements

1. Forest Biome Overhaul:

Random Generation: The forest biome now features randomly generated trees, grass, and ground, creating a unique experience every time you explore.
Enhanced Visuals: Improved textures and models for a more immersive forest environment.


2. Pre-generated Plaza:

 The Plaza remains a pre-rendered area, offering a consistent hub for players.


3. New Town Location:

 Buildings Introduced: Explore the town with newly added structures such as the Blacksmith and Adventurer’s Inn.
 Future Functionality: While these buildings are accessible, their functionalities, such as crafting swords at the Blacksmith and resting or buying food at the Inn, will be introduced in the upcoming NPC Interaction Update.


Roadmap for Future Updates
We have an exciting roadmap ahead as we continue to develop and enhance the world of 001 Earth:

1. World Generation and World Map/Traveling Features:

 Our immediate focus will be on further enhancing world generation and introducing new biomes such as swamps, grasslands, and more.
 A comprehensive world map and traveling feature will be implemented to facilitate navigation between these biomes.


2. Structure Update:

 After completing the world generation and world map/traveling features, we will release the Structure Update, enabling players to enter and explore buildings in the town.


3. NPC Interaction Update:

 Following the Structure Update, we will introduce the NPC Interaction Update, allowing players to interact with NPCs within buildings to access services such as crafting at the Blacksmith and resting or buying food at the Adventurer's Inn.


We appreciate your patience and support as we continue to enhance and expand 001 Earth. Your feedback is invaluable, so please keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions with us.

Jump back into the adventure and explore the new features in 001 Earth!

Best wishes,
CGNDC

notes.title: 001 Earth rework update part 3/3
notes.notes:
Patch Notes - Version 0.0.1.3

Greetings, adventurers of 001 Earth! Prepare yourselves for an epic journey as we introduce the first phase of our comprehensive update. Here's what's new:
Complete Rewrite:


 We've meticulously rebuilt 001 Earth from the ground up to ensure a seamless and immersive gaming experience. Bid farewell to pesky bugs as we pave the way for smoother gameplay.

Enhanced Combat Mechanics:


 Dive into battle with enhanced character movements and attacks. Explore new depths of strategy as you wield an expanded arsenal of weapons and don upgraded armor.

Temporary Adjustments:


 To refine our combat mechanics, some features such as world generation, travel map, and inventory have been temporarily disabled. Rest assured, these beloved elements will return stronger than ever.

Exciting Additions Await:


 Brace yourselves for the grand unveiling of a diverse array of weapons, each boasting complete animations for maximum immersion. Your arsenal is about to undergo a transformation like never before.

Phase Three Highlights:


 Prepare for the ultimate evolution of combat as Phase Three of our journey unfolds. Here's what's in store:

Duck Down Maneuver: Introducing a new defensive tactic to your arsenal, adventurers can now execute the "Duck Down" maneuver. Take cover swiftly to evade enemy attacks or prepare for a strategic counterstrike. Master this skill to outmaneuver your foes and emerge victorious in the heat of battle.


Roll Forward: Embrace agility and fluidity with the addition of the "Roll Forward" ability. Swiftly evade incoming threats or close the distance between you and your target with a dynamic roll maneuver. Whether you're dodging projectiles or closing in for a decisive strike, the Roll Forward offers unparalleled versatility in combat.


Precision Strikes: Enhance your combat prowess with precision strikes, targeting specific areas of your opponent's body. Utilize both left and right-hand attacks to exploit vulnerabilities in your enemy's defenses. With the ability to target the upper, middle, and lower regions of the body, strategic precision becomes the key to victory on the battlefield.


Expanded Combat Dynamics: With the addition of these new maneuvers and precision strikes, combat in 001 Earth reaches new heights of depth and intensity. Engage in exhilarating encounters where every move matters and tactical ingenuity reigns supreme. Adapt your strategy on the fly, exploit your opponent's weaknesses, and emerge triumphant in the face of adversity.





Embark on this journey with us as we continue to evolve and refine 001 Earth. Your feedback and support are invaluable as we shape the future of our beloved world. Prepare yourselves for the challenges and triumphs that await!

Rigid lines have been smoothed out, resulting in cleaner character designs. Additionally, animation frames have been refined for smoother transitions between poses.  Introducing Balance Mechanics: Embrace a new layer of tactical depth with the introduction of balance mechanics. Every step you take now holds significance as it impacts your character's balance. Navigate cautiously, for reckless movements may lead to stumbling and unexpected falls. Exercise precision and caution in your every move, brave adventurers!


 Movement Glitches Fixed: Bid farewell to the frustrations of movement glitches as we've diligently combed through every aspect to ensure a smoother and more fluid experience. Say hello to seamless navigation as you traverse the dynamic world of 001 Earth with newfound precision and grace.


 Refined Camera Movements: Your perspective is our priority, and we're thrilled to unveil a comprehensive overhaul of camera movements. Say goodbye to jarring transitions and hello to fluid, immersive views that effortlessly capture the breathtaking landscapes awaiting your exploration.



Embark on this journey with us as we continue to evolve and refine 001 Earth. Your feedback and support are invaluable as we shape the future of our beloved world. Prepare yourselves for the challenges and triumphs that await!

notes.title: 001 Earth v0.0.0.3 [Performance Update]
notes.notes:
Improved Performance and Minor Bug Fixes

We noticed a lag spike when playing the game. This issue is now fixed and the game should run smoother now.

There was a display bug when changing campaigns. When you played the 001 Earth campaign and changed to another campaign,  the screen still shows the 001 Earth campaign. This issue is now fixed.


If you found a bug, please do report it on our discord server

Thank you.

~CGNDC
